answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 14 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 395 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. What carries the tundra here is verification, the copper of cost is what stops the farm, and the mesa of the record keeps every claim checkable.
